item.description:
Postman v7.3.6

Bug Fixes

  • [GitHub #6899] - Fixed an issue where slashes were not displayed properly in response body
  • [GitHub #6947] - Fixed an issue where data after backslash was getting encoded even if is was not an escape sequence
  • [GitHub #6991] - Fixed an issue where new lines and quotes were not displayed properly in response body
  • [GitHub #6383] - Fixed a bug where tabs used to go in conflicted mode
  • [GitHub #6876] - Fixed an issue where response body was not getting copied using context menu action

Postman v7.3.5

Bug Fixes

  • [GitHub #7001] - Fixed an issue where SSO login was not working for Enterprise login

Postman v7.3.4

Breaking Changes

  • Discontinue support for 32-bit Linux

Improvements

  • [GitHub #6595] - Improved pm.variables.has method to search in all the scopes
  • [GitHub #6699] - Updated response viewer to show headers in a tabular view
  • [GitHub #6414] - Updated request headers to be title case for consistency
  • Updated response-viewer to show different stages of request accurately
  • This release replaces the rich editor used for displaying the response from Ace Editor to Monaco editor.
  • In addition to changing the editor for the response section, the pretty view no longer does transformations on the response text. All transformations are handled as text formatters inside the editor.
  • Combined, these two above changes give better performance, reduced memory footprint and remove bugs in response pretty view.

Bug Fixes

  • [GitHub #4721] - Fixed an issue where app crashed on de-structured usage of pm assertions
  • [GitHub #4591] - Fixed an issue where collection runner was not identifying JSON format when selecting data file
  • [GitHub #5381] - Fixed an issue where export collection dialogue breaks on expanding (macOS)
  • [GitHub #4412] - Fixed an issue where loader window was not appearing centered on using multiple monitors on Linux
  • [GitHub #6784] - Fixed a bug where parsing CSV file containing double quotes as escape character caused error
  • [GitHub #6752] - Fix a bug causing app to crash when form-data has malformed file value
  • [GitHub #6140] - Fixed a bug where multipart/form-data boundary was inconsistent for digest auth
  • [GitHub #6651] - Fixed a bug where pm.sendRequest crashes the app for the non-string raw body
  • [GitHub #6761] - Fixed a bug causing non utf8 charset responses to not show in the response-viewer
  • [GitHub #6764] - Fixed a bug where using quotes inside unquoted csv field caused error
  • [GitHub #6730] - Fixed a bug where collection export was not working when example request was empty
  • [GitHub #6754] - Fixed a bug where undo history was reset after performing a beautify action
  • [GitHub #1465] - Fixed a bug where floating point numbers were rounded off in response pretty view
  • [GitHub #5712] - Fixed a bug where JSON response pretty view removed extra characters surrounding the JSON text
  • [GitHub #6150] - Fixed a bug where emoji in response viewer caused uneven line heights
  • [GitHub #6103] - Fixed a bug where search pop-up would hide the scrollbar in response pretty view
  • [GitHub #6807] - Fixed a bug where cookies were not stored when the cookie path did not match the request path
  • [GitHub #6767] - Fixed an issue where collection sidebar history items did not have pointer cursor on hover
  • [GitHub #6860] - Fixed a bug where links in response view were encoded when opened in a Tab
  • [GitHub #6891] - Fixed a bug in Examples causing editor to beautify on every key-stroke
  • [GitHub #6932] - Fixed an issue where app was opening only once by clicking on 'Run in Postman' button and not launching again.
  • [GitHub #6886] - Fixed an issue where requests sent to servers that use TLS renegotiation were not working
  • [GitHub #6895] - Fixed issue where OAuth2 window was showing blank screen on requesting token
  • [GitHub #6887] - Fixed a bug where changing the response language was not formatting correctly

Postman v7.2.2

Improvements

  • Upgraded the Swagger importer to v0.0.2. Full changelog at https://go.pstmn.io/swagger-changelog
  • Upgraded the OpenAPI importer to v0.0.15. Full changelog at https://go.pstmn.io/openapi-changelog
  • Upgraded the cURL importer to v0.0.4. Full changelog at https://go.pstmn.io/curl-changelog
  • [GitHub #5760] - Added fork labels in all collection listing views
  • [GitHub #4751] - Fixed some performance issue to handle large response

Features

  • [GitHub #2724] - Added new code generators behind an experimental flag
  • [GitHub #1667] - Added support for cookie syncing via the Interceptor

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed a bug causing cookie settings in runner to not persist when rerun
  • [GitHub #3178] - Updated internal CSV parser to fix bugs with data files parsing in runner
  • [GitHub #6509] - Increased request label length in sidebar
  • [GitHub #6592] - Bubbled up response save error to show in UI
  • [GitHub #6745] - Fixed an issue where multiple accounts could not remain signed-in simultaneously

Postman v7.2.0

Features

  • [GitHub #1669] - Added support for GraphQL request and schemas
  • [GitHub #6360] - Updated collection runner to support selecting and reordering requests/folders before run
  • [GitHub #971] - Added faker library support to add $random* dynamic variables

Improvements

  • [GitHub #5992] - Fixed an issue where the request URL is shown instead of request name when trying to save the request to another collection
  • [GitHub #6344] - Added password masking to client certificate passphrase
  • Revised placeholder copy for adding a description
  • Removed last modified just now from collection browser
  • Fixed an issue where description support markdown does not link to any documentation.
  • Invite multiple users by uploading .txt or .csv files

Bug Fixes

  • [GitHub #5671] - Fixed a bug where browse view History items are unclickable
  • [GitHub #6494] - Fixed a bug where workspace delete modal does not show thumbnail in the collection runner
  • [GitHub #5916] - Fixed a bug where app was crashing due to client certificate password mismatch
  • [GitHub #2427] - Fixed a bug where URL path variables were not parsed correctly
  • [GitHub #6537] - Fixed a bug where params with empty keys were getting filtered
  • [GitHub #6533] - Fixed a bug where invalid url crashes the app
  • Fixed a bug where long collection name breaks UI in collection browser and add folder modal
  • Fixed an issue where key value editors have inconsistent borders and overlaps with borders of 2 pane view
  • Fixed a bug where upgrade button did not refresh to team button on plan upgrade

Postman v7.1.1

Bug Fixes

  • [GitHub #6524] Fixed a bug where search in sidebar would continue to show results from previous search results
  • [GitHub #6505] Fixed a bug where workspace collections view in browse mode was crashing if collection owner account was deleted
  • [GitHub #6527] Fixed a bug where users were unable to open a new tab on clicking plus icon in some flows
  • [Github #6534] Fixed a bug where users were unable to send files while sending requests
  • [GitHub #6364] Fixed a bug that caused proxy matching for URL with ports to fail

Postman v7.1.0

Features

Introducing APIs in Postman

  • Create APIs directly within the Postman desktop or web app
  • Add and edit your schemas, and generate collections from them at the click of a button
  • Link related entities such as collections, environments, mock servers, and monitors to APIs
  • Version your APIs, and tag collections under them to keep track of changes
  • Mock, document, monitor and publish multiple versions of your API simultaneously using tagged revisions of collections

Improvements

  • [GitHub #4320] Improved the ability to work with files and fixed issues around file exports
  • [GitHub #1228] Added support for cookie control in collection runner
  • [GitHub #4842] Added support for accessing cookies in pm.sendRequest
  • [GitHub #2458] Added support for payload hash in Hawk authentication
  • Signing out now warns you if you have any unsynced changes
  • You can now close the last open tab in a workspace
  • Added support for adding asynchronous tests when using pm.test by passing done callback

Bug Fixes

  • [GitHub #6378] Fixed a bug where group history delete action used to crash the app
  • [GitHub #3281] Fixed a bug where quotes get encoded in query parameters
  • [GitHub #5860] Fixed a bug where cookies are not saved for IPv6 addresses
  • [GitHub #5753] Fixed a bug where pm.sendRequest cookies are not saved in the app
  • [GitHub #6431] Fixed a bug where team notifications were not shown in the same app session where the team was created
  • [GitHub #5074] Fixed a bug where sometimes the request count in the collection was different from the actual number of requests shown
  • [GitHub #5524] Fixed a bug where folders with invalid references to requests were not allowed to be deleted or duplicated
  • [GitHub #4840] Fixed a bug where dragging a duplicate key inside environments modal is dragging 2 rows with it
  • [GitHub #5545] Fixed a bug where markdown renders with incorrect spacing
  • [GitHub #5226] Fixed a bug where next and previous buttons in the ace editor search box work exactly opposite to intended functionality
  • [GitHub #5613] Fixed a bug where after saving the request the first duplicate key in query params is deleted
  • [GitHub #5245] Fixed a bug where the last user in team workspace doesn't see a proper error message in toasts while leaving workspace
  • [GitHub #6063] Fixed a bug where method name not showing up for older history in browse mode
  • [Github #5558] Fixed an issue where Postman was getting set as the default app to handle HTML files on Linux
  • [Github #6362] Fixed an issue where editing the description of a variable via the environment quick look also edits the description of other variables
  • Fixed issues while importing Postman data dumps
  • Various bugfixes in the OpenAPI 3.0 importer
  • Fixed URL encoding issues while calculating payload hash in multiple authorizer modules
  • Fixed a bug where the request body button types are not vertically aligned in the center

Postman v7.0.9

Features

  • Users can now suggest people to be invited to their team
  • [Github #3290] Added support for custom CA certificate
  • [GitHub #2494] Added support for PFX client certificate
  • [GitHub #4631] Added support for request mutation using pre-request scripts
  • [GitHub #3566] Added support for Proxy authentication (Basic Auth)
  • [GitHub #2282] Added request size details in tooltip
  • Added detailed timings in the tooltip of response time
  • Added support for API Key type authentication

Improvements

  • Improvement of UI representation of temporary headers

Bug Fixes

  • [GitHub #5799] Fixed a bug where interrupting the script execution crashes the App
  • [GitHub #4707] Fixed a bug where port 443 is not matched implicitly when using client certificates
  • [GitHub #3232] Fixed a bug where AWS signature was not calculated correctly
  • [GitHub #6174] Fixed a bug where error responses during team invite flows were not bubbled up
  • [GitHub #6179] Fixed a bug where Postman Runner doesn't show Pre-request script assertion results
  • [GitHub #5594] Fixed a bug where the Test filter is not working when retrying the run in collection runner
  • [GitHub #6178] Fixed a bug where open tabs can't be selected in the find and replace section
  • [GitHub #2833] Fixed issue where Postman window opened off-screen on restoring from minimized state
  • [GitHub #4828] Fixed issue where Postman window was always opening in windowed mode despite closing in maximized mode
  • [GitHub #5639] Fixed an issue where collection gets imported multiple times when clicking Run in Postman button [Windows]
  • [GitHub #6239] Fixed a bug where the app doesn't receive sync changes after clicking the sync icon
  • Fixed a bug where the sync indicator was wrong incase where sync was disabled for a user
  • Fixed a bug where removing a collection after creating it in the same app session was not synced
  • [GitHub #6144] Fixed a bug where environment values were not updated immediately after the request finishes
  • [GitHub #4833] Fixed a bug where add account and cancel flow did not use to load the correct window for the user
  • [Github #2893] Fixed a bug where examples in the original request were not copied when saving it request as a new request
  • [GitHub #5932] Context menu does not show up in Import modal (Paste Raw Text)
  • Fixed UI issue in console related to clear button and search box
  • [GitHub #5965] Fixed a bug where the app was crashing while opening another 3rd party App using custom protocol from an OAuth2 window
  • [GitHub #3955] Fixed some inconsistencies in rendering markdown between Postman Dashboard/Documentation and Postman App
  • [Github #5654] Fixed editing variables from the quick look when the order of session-variable is not the same as variables
  • [GitHub #5690] Fixed a bug where environment dropdown on applying a filter has empty spaces/rows
  • Fixed a bug in request name where if the name is too large then it wraps onto multiple lines
  • Fixed a bug in request name where if the user has only view permissions still it is able to edit the name
  • [GitHub #4951] Fixed issue where a saved cookie is not removed when the cookie is updated by subdomain with a prior expiration date
  • [GitHub #3565] Fixed issue where user cannot edit cookies with the same name under the same domain but has a different path
  • [GitHub #5518] Fixed example title is too short in the dropdown list of examples issue
  • [GitHub #2940] Fixed a bug where highlighting text while renaming request in Sidebar drags the whole request
  • [GitHub #6292] Fixed a bug where example response preview sections was not working
  • [GitHub #5758] Fixed a bug where selection focus is lost from request URL when path variables are removed
  • Added UI feedback states when setting up an account after signing in. Without this, quitting the app might lead to corrupted data
  • Fix for no-cache and postman-token settings
  • [GitHub #4613] Fixed issue regarding correctly focusing the requester window when a user tries to create another app instance
  • Fixed focusing issue related to the search box inside the text editor

Postman v7.0.7

  • Fixed a bug where raw body was not synced correctly for history requests #6093

Postman v7.0.6

Improvements

  • New & improved permission management system
  • Improved the performance of syncing

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed issue regarding visualization of x-www-form-urlencoded parameters in Postman console #5096
  • Show year in the collection activity feed #5188
  • Fixed console not opening on switching accounts #5409
  • Fixed toggling sidebar via keyboard doesn't change 'Show/Hide Sidebar' button state #5505
  • Fixed rendering of disabled body parameters in Postman console #5207
  • Fixed an issue where falsy values were not rendered in Postman console #5306
  • Fixed the issue of Postman console removing extra whitespaces from the string #5743
  • Added titles for path variables and query params #3350
  • Content-Type support for form-data multipart #1104
  • Fixed collection description value and width in edit mode (Collection Browser) #5276
  • Fixed rendering of disabled headers in Postman console #3302
  • Bugfix for search results in collection selector UI #5490
  • Fixed an issue where the app was not clearing old app updates #5034
  • Fixed an issue where the tooltip for system-generated headers blocks the header-value #4894
  • Fixed an issue where the console search field was not allowing users to paste copied text through the mouse #5358
  • Fixed Response Cookie Expiration Date not showing
  • Add word-break for long response header values
  • Fixed the issue of wrong pathname being displayed in Postman console

Postman v6.7.4

Improvements

  • Added support for disabling keyboard shortcuts #2707

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue that caused the file path to disappear while reordering form-data fields #2651
  • Fixed an issue that caused errors with self-signed SSL certificates in OAuth2 #5819

item.title: 1.19.60 (Beta)
item.description:
Improvements & Bugfixes

  • Flashcards: Added turn on/off hide all test one commands.

  • All Notes Page: Improved search to find Chinese results when using Ctrl+F or Cmd+F.

  • Flashcards: Improved image occlusion test in sequence UI.

  • PDF Viewer: Added progress percentage and loading spinner when uploading a source.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed tool resetting to "Text select" after starting to take notes in the editor or highlight section.

  • AI Tools: Enhanced multi-line card AI generation and editor behavior for code blocks.

  • YouTube Annotator: Added link in "Video Unplayable" section when video cannot be displayed.

  • AI Tools: Fixed bad translation syntax in AI tutor hover tooltip.

  • All Notes Page: Fixed missing loading bar after choosing the empty trash button.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed beta text reading mode issues and power-up tags remaining after changing translation language.

  • Translations: Translated keyboard shortcut names and setting names.

item.title: 1.19.59 (Beta)
item.description:
New

Translations

  • We’ve added comprehensive translations! We currently have translations for:

    • English

    • Brazilian Portuguese

    • Chinese (Simplified)

    • German

    • Russian

    • Polish

  • We will be releasing a new community translation portal in the coming days to enable the community to add translations to additional languages. Our new setup will make adding additional languages easy.

Text Reading Mode

  • You can now view any PDF in "Text Mode" for easy reading! Read a nicely-formatted text version of you document, with all images, math, tables, etc maintained.

  • Easily navigate up/down with your keyboard while reading.

  • Listen to your document with text-to-speech.

Bugs

  • Editor: Added generic title detection in link plugin.

  • PDF Viewer: Disabled full-screen mode button on mobile devices.

item.title: 1.19.58 (Beta)
item.description:
Improvements & Bugs

  • AI Tools: Fixed "Convert image to text" labs feature not applying formatting properly.

  • Editor: Fixed area highlight not getting reset on Cmd+Tab.

  • AI Tools: Enhanced Prompt AI tab completion to avoid making too short suggestions.

  • Editor: Improved right-to-left mode support.

  • Editor: Enhanced google drive embeds to handle video playback errors.

  • Flashcards: Improved FSRS optimizer performance.

  • PDF Viewer: Improved OCR summary regeneration after PDF processing.

  • Editor: Fixed Safari Cmd+Shift+V paste not working in rich text editor.

  • Editor: Fixed plain text pasting to parse image URLs correctly.

  • Editor: Fixed /isp shortcode conflict between Insert Search Portal and Superscript.

  • Flashcards: Fixed label "Add/Remove to Back of Card" to update reactively on click.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed uploaded audio files pointing at local URLs on the desktop app.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed iPad abandoning highlight creation after cursor release.

  • Plugin SDK: Fixed insertMarkdown function not formatting markdown correctly.

  • Subscriptions: Fixed overflows on mobile pricing page.

  • Tables: Fixed LaTeX not rendering properly in tables.

  • YouTube Annotator: Added proper error message for videos which can't be played outside YouTube.

  • Backend: Optimized creating new synced knowledge bases.

item.title: 1.19.57 (Beta)
item.description:
Bug Fixes

  • AI Tools: Improved LaTeX AI button functionality.

  • Syncing: Added easier re-authenticate button on the syncing page.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed PDF upload button not visible in non-English languages.

  • Advanced Tables: Fixed columns not displaying until refresh when restored from trash.

  • AI Tools: Fixed Google warning incorrectly appearing for non-Google models.

  • Implemented: Improved "Disable all flashcard features" polish suggestions.

  • Editor: Fixed slash command "Todo" doing nothing when triggered.

  • Editor: Fixed copying URL from rem used as hyperlink target not giving the best URL.

  • Flashcards: Fixed confetti getting stuck sometimes.

  • Flashcards: Fixed scheduling causing too many iterations when scheduling forward.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed bottom panel showing for inline paywalls.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed automatic re-focus on "Highlights" pane after adding area highlight on mobile.

  • Queue: Fixed sync not reliably removing finished cards from non-main queue.

  • Simple Tables: Fixed shift-click table bullet failing to open in new pane.

  • Desktop App: Fixed macOS bug preventing folder selection for local-only storage.

Improvements

  • Editor: Added customizable shortcut for collapse descendants functionality.

  • Knowledge Base Switcher: Improved knowledge base switcher menu drag handle icon visibility.

  • AI Tools: Moved "Add cards in a portal" option to advanced settings.

Bugs

  • AI Tools: Fixed Gemini 2.5 Pro preview not working.

  • AI Tools: Fixed AI tools not working with huge images.

  • Flashcards: Fixed tinygraph rebuild getting stuck while refreshing for some users..

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed RemNote OCR failing on specific PDF files.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed inability to select and resize/move area highlights which created new highlights instead.

  • Subscriptions: Fixed transaction failed error requiring tab restart after download.

  • Syncing: Added a suggestion to optimize your local DB

  • Syncing: Added a better progress bar for the initial sync login.

New

  • Labs: Added an AI convert to text shortcut for pasted images.

Bugs

  • Simple Tables: Fixed card table columns not properly showing enabled status.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed area highlight mode accidentally activating when using Ctrl (Cmd) shortcuts.

  • Queue: Fixed go back button being unavailable for simple tables while the shortcut still worked.

  • Subscriptions: Fixed paywall dialog not closing when clicking X or invite friends link.

  • Subscriptions: Fixed duplicate Get Started button appearing on free tier in settings page.

Major Improvements

  • Syncing: The initial sync after login now uses significantly less device resources and is considerably faster.

  • AI Tools: Significantly improve AI grading

  • AI Tools: Added support for AI summaries on long PDFs and long sources.

New

  • Editor: Added 'Collapse All Descendants' functionality and updated keyboard shortcuts.

  • Editor: Added 'Remove All Tags' command to slash commands.

  • PDF Viewer: Added fullscreen focus mode for PDFs.

  • AI Tools: Added Claude 4 for AI chat.

  • Queue: Added "Documents In" display in the queue flashcards section.

Improvements and Bugs

  • AI Tools: Significantly improved AI grading performance.

  • AI Tools: Improved AI chat auto-scrolling behavior.

  • AI Tools: Updated bulk AI card generation to prevent section previews from appearing outside screen boundaries.

  • Editor: Improved hierarchy editor selection context menu to conditionally render tooltip and text based on window size.

  • Editor: Added tooltip when hovering over 4+ children that displays the tooltip for better user guidance.

  • Editor: Reduced the number of red flag icons in the UI for a cleaner appearance.

  • Flashcards: Updated concept card instructions to write cards on the same line.

  • Simple Tables: Improved card view switching from entire table to individual cells to not auto-enable practice for all columns.

  • AI Tools: Fixed AI chat flashcards getting saved to the most recently used PDF when it's closed.

  • Editor: Fixed Esc key being caught by ControlledPopup instead of super-popup when miscellaneous popup is opened on top.

  • Editor: Fixed toggle todo status functionality for multiple rems.

  • Editor: Fixed transaction aborted error on iOS.

  • Queue: Fixed queue overflow in some slides.

  • YouTube Annotator: Fixed some YouTube transcripts not loading properly.

  • YouTube Annotator: Fixed YouTube video icon getting replaced with PDF icon after generating flashcards from video.

  • YouTube Annotator: Improved error message when a video is too long to use with the annotator.

Improvements & Bugfixes

  • Simple Tables: Improved table creation performance.

  • Desktop App: Added spinner when switching update channel.

  • AI Tools: Improved balance of creating Concept/Definition cards for AI generator.

  • AI Tools: Fixed "add cards in a portal" option back for AI bulk card creation.

  • AI Tools: Fixed magic copy paste crash when user tries to use deprecated model.

  • Editor: Fixed Link Source /isrc command not working inside folder names.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed PDF text select also dragging on mobile devices.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed uploading consecutive PDFs as sources incorrectly redirecting.

  • YouTube Annotator: Fixed failed YouTube caption fetch.

Bugs

  • Audio Upload: Fixed upload audio trigger displaying "Upload Image" text instead of correct label.

  • PDF Viewer: Fixed downloading PDF files on Electron desktop app.

  • AI Tools: Fixed AI Tutor not receiving card text as context when opening cards from the cards table.

  • AI Tools: Fixed table AI autofill functionality that was broken.

  • AI Tools: Updated to latest Gemini Pro 2.5 model.

  • Queue: Fixed multiple reminder push notifications being sent to users.

  • Search: Fixed Windows app unable to find Chinese search tokenizer.

Bugfixes

  • All Notes Page: Fixed issue where learning page couldn't be closed when opened in the all notes preview pane.

  • Audio Files: Fixed confusing state where uploaded audio files would appear as the document title in the global uploader.

  • Flashcards: Fixed inability to add or edit Image Occlusions for some Area Highlights.

item.title: June 3, 2025. Design updates and refinements in version 2.11.0
item.description:
Features and improvements
  • Revamped the design of tab bar, authorization window, settings window, and error pages to better match the overall TradingView platform style
  • Improved the stability of symbol syncing, resolving several minor related issues
  • Updated subscription level badges in the app's main menu for accurate display
Bug fixes
  • Resolved authentication issue with markets.com broker when signing in via Apple ID

item.title: April 22, 2025. Design updates and bug fixes in version 2.10.0
item.description:
Features and improvements
  • Updated the appearance of dialogs and the autosave splash screen to better match the overall TradingView platform style
Bug fixes
  • Fixed an issue where the New tab wouldn't automatically reflect the selected language after changing the app's language
  • Resolved a permission request issue when connecting to brokers: Coinbase, OKX, and Markets.com
  • Fixed a bug where canceling the "Close tab?" dialog on the screener page would still result in the tab closing

item.title: February 25, 2025. Hotfix for an app crash in version 2.9.6
item.description:
Bug fixes
  • Resolved a crash on app launch caused by the error: “Rpc: host not initialized”

item.title: February 13, 2025. Updates and refinements in version 2.9.5
item.description:
With this release, we stopped supporting macOS versions earlier than Big Sur (version 11), including macOS Catalina (version 10.15). On affected operating systems, app versions prior to 2.9.5 will continue to work but will no longer receive updates.

Features and improvements
  • Updated the "Screeners" product list on the New Tab to reflect recent updates to the TradingView Screeners
  • Added symbol syncing to Markets, Symbols and Calendar pages
Bug fixes
  • Fixed an issue where unsupported Iranian and Swedish locales would appear in the app
  • Resolved authentication issues with Pepperstone broker via Facebook
  • Fixed a bug where the Main Menu did not open on the first click
  • Addressed an issue where the context menu of a product on the New Tab only worked on the second click
  • Fixed visual bugs in the titlebar that appeared when tabs were too small
  • Fixed small visual bugs in the Main Menu and the dialogs on the New Tab
  • Resolved an issue where the application would attempt to connect to a proxy server even if its parameters were invalid

item.title: December 12, 2024. Updates and refinements in version 2.9.4
item.description:
Features and improvements
  • Some slight but still important UI improvements across the app
Bug fixes
  • Fixed an issue where the application failed to save the username for the DNSE broker
  • Resolved a permission request error when connecting to the tastytrade broker

item.title: October 17, 2024. News Flow added to the New Tab and other updates in version 2.9.3
item.description:
Features and improvements
  • The New Tab now features a “News Flow” tile, replacing the previous “News” tile and directing users to the News Flow page
  • Revamped the appearance of several icons in the Settings menu
Bug fixes
  • Fixed an issue preventing newly added alert notification sounds from playing
  • Resolved an issue blocking connections to Trade Nation via Apple ID or LinkedIn
  • Fixed a permission request issue when connecting to the HTX broker

item.title: September 04, 2024. Hotfixes in version 2.9.2
item.description:
Bug fixes
  • Fixed permission request issue when connecting to broker Errante
  • Resolved crashes related to:
    - Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'split')
    - Render frame was disposed before WebFrameMain could be accessed

item.title: August 29, 2024. Refinements to the app closing process in version 2.9.1
item.description:
Features and improvements
  • Further refinements to the app closing process to enhance stability
Bug fixes
  • Corrected the tab title for the Bond Screener
  • Resolved crashes related to:
    - SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression

item.title: August 19, 2024. Polishing the New Tab with version 2.9.0
item.description:
Features and improvements
  • Updated the look of the Products section in the New Tab and added new products:
    - Bond Screener and DEX Screener
    - Options
  • Started refining the app closing process to improve stability, with more updates planned
Bug fixes
  • Resolved an issue preventing Google account sign-in to publish a video idea on YouTube
  • Addressed an issue with Google account sign-in for connecting to the “Trade Nation” broker
  • Fixed background shift on the New Tab when there was horizontal scrolling
  • Addressed issues where symbol syncing and saving broker credentials did not work correctly on chart tabs
  • Addressed an issue where the “All layouts” button was missing on the New Tab

item.title: July 9th, 2024. Hotfix in version 2.8.1
item.description:
Bug fixes
  • Fixed an application launch issue that caused the Pine Editor to appear empty and prevented the watchlist from showing up in tabs

item.title: July 1st, 2024. New Tab becomes even newer in version 2.8.0
item.description:
Features and improvements
  • We have revamped the look of the New Tab for a more modern and user-friendly experience, with more focus on the entire family of TradingView products and tools
Bug fixes
  • Fixed the issue with the media permission request when trying to log in to a broker
  • Resolved crashes related to:
    - Render frame was disposed before WebFrameMain could be accessed

item.title: June 6th, 2024. Integrated link handling in version 2.7.8
item.description:
Features and improvements
  • Enabled integrated link handling for all supported locales on Windows (previously available for English locale only). Links to TradingView charts and ideas now bypass the default browser, opening directly within the desktop app for Windows. This change ensures faster access and a more seamless workflow. item.title: July 2025 - WebCatalog Atlas Browser Extension
item.description:
We're excited to introduce WebCatalog Atlas browser extension. Atlas transforms your new tab page into a beautifully organized app launcher. Access your favorite web apps, organize them with folders and pages, and personalize your dashboard with wallpapers—all synced across your devices. Available for Chrome, Edge, Opera, Brave, Vivaldi, and other Chromium-based browsers.

Singlebox on the Microsoft Store

Singlebox is now available on the Microsoft Store with installation and updates fully managed by Microsoft. IT admins can also deploy Singlebox via Microsoft Intune for easy distribution across devices in your organization.

Vertical Tab Bar

You can now switch the tab bar from horizontal to vertical. Go to App/Space Settings → Appearance → Tab Bar → Orientation and select Vertical.

The vertical tab bar includes built-in search functionality for quick tab navigation.

Tab Search

If you're not using the vertical tab bar, you can still search for tabs with:

  • Keyboard: Ctrl + Shift + A (Windows) or Shift + Command + A (macOS)
  • Mouse: Click the arrow icon on the horizontal tab bar

Google Profile Integration

When installing Google apps (Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, etc.) from WebCatalog Desktop, the app now automatically sets the subspace's name and icon to the name and profile picture of the Google account. You can still manually customize them if needed.

Site Permissions

Previously, websites could automatically access sensitive system features like your camera, microphone, clipboard, file system, and notifications without asking for permission. Now, WebCatalog asks for your explicit approval before granting access to these features, giving you better control over your privacy and security.

When a website requests access to sensitive features, you'll see a permission prompt that lets you allow or deny the request. You can manage these permissions anytime in App/Space Settings → Security & Privacy → Site Permissions.

Blog

We've launched a new blog to share our latest news, tips, and tricks. You can find it at webcatalog.io/blog.

item.title: June 2025 - WebCatalog Atlas
item.description:
WebCatalog Atlas is the new home page for WebCatalog Desktop. Atlas is a beautiful, customizable dashboard that lets you search, manage, and organize your apps and spaces.

Tabs

One of our most requested features is finally here: Tabs! You can now open multiple tabs for your apps—just like in your favorite web browser.

Horizontal Subspace Bar

Prefer a horizontal layout? You can now switch the subspace bar from vertical to horizontal. Go to App/Space Settings → Appearance → Subspace Bar → Orientation and select Horizontal.

Autoplay Policy

To reduce unwanted video/audio playback (especially with multiple tabs or subspaces), autoplay is now blocked by default until you interact with the website. Want to always allow autoplay? Go to App/Space Settings → General → Autoplay Policy. You can also configure this setting per subspace.

Customizable Toolbar Buttons

Take control of your workspace! You can now show, hide, and rearrange toolbar buttons. Customize them under App/Space Settings → Appearance, or simply rearrange them directly on the toolbar.

Affiliate Program

We're excited to launch the WebCatalog Affiliate Program! Refer WebCatalog to your audience and earn up to 30% of the first year's revenue for every referral you drive. No cap on earnings — the more you share, the more you earn.

item.title: May 2025 - Dashboard Wallpapers
item.description:
You can now personalize your app and space dashboards with stunning curated wallpapers from our library—or upload your own images for a more customized experience.

Deep Linking

Previously, you couldn't send links between apps and spaces in WebCatalog Desktop. We've now upgraded the link handling system to make that possible. For example, if you click a Google Docs link inside the Google Drive app, it can now open directly in the Google Docs app instead of your web browser. As part of this upgrade, we've also improved the interfaces and fixed many issues related to link handling.

Community

We're excited to launch the WebCatalog Community—a place to ask questions, share feedback, and connect with other users and the WebCatalog team.

item.title: April 2025 - Command Menu
item.description:
We're introducing the Command Menu, a powerful new way to quickly access and execute commands, as well as launch subspaces in any installed apps, games, or spaces.

To open the command menu,

  • press Ctrl + Shift + P (Windows) or Command (⌘) + Shift (⇧) + P (macOS)
  • or click on the rocket icon on the toolbar.
  • or select View > Command from the menu bar.

item.title: February 2025 - Shared Spaces
item.description:
WebCatalog Business users can now create shared spaces, enabling teams to collaborate effortlessly by accessing and managing the same spaces together.

Shared spaces work just like regular spaces, with one key difference: all data—including subspaces, bookmarks, and settings—is synchronized and shared across the entire team.

item.title: January 2025 - Smarter, Faster Search Experience
item.description:
Search has always been central to WebCatalog, helping you quickly find and explore apps. However, as WebCatalog grew, search didn't always keep up—it could feel slow, unreliable, and less helpful than it should be.

We've completely rebuilt the search system to be faster, more dependable, and powered by advanced AI technology. Now, with AI-driven language models, search is smarter and more intuitive, delivering better results and more accurate app suggestions.

This update also sets the stage for exciting new features that will make discovering and managing apps even easier. Stay tuned!

Important: To keep using search, update WebCatalog Desktop to version 62+ and all apps, games, and spaces to Photon version 53+. Older versions will soon lose search functionality due to major infrastructure changes.

Improved App Update Notifications

We've improved how update notifications work based on your feedback. While updates are essential for bringing you new features and keeping your installed desktop apps and spaces secure, we understand that receiving frequent update notifications can be disruptive.

To make this better, we've reduced the frequency of update notifications and added new customization options:

  • Choose to receive notifications for all updates, only major updates, or turn them off entirely.
  • By default, you'll only receive notifications for major updates.

You can adjust these settings in App/space settings > General > App update notifications.

Additionally, you can customize the app update reminder on the toolbar by going to app/space settings > Appearance > Show app update reminder on toolbar.

item.title: December 2024 - Subspace Bar Customization
item.description:
We've introduced new customization options for the subspace bar, allowing you to tailor it to your preferences:

  • Customize the subspace captions (the text appears under the name of each subspace) on the subspace bar. Options include showing keyboard shortcuts, URLs, hostnames, or hiding captions entirely.
  • You can now hide the "Add Subspace" button on the subspace bar.

You can change these settings in App/Space Settings > Appearance.

item.title: November 2024 - Google Drive Integration
item.description:
WebCatalog Desktop now works with the official Google Drive desktop sync client for macOS and Windows. This integration allows you to open Google Drive files (Docs, Sheets, Slides, Drawings, and Forms) directly in corresponding desktop apps.

To open Google Drive files with any installed desktop apps or spaces.

  • Use the "Open with" options in Windows Explorer (Windows) or Finder (macOS).
  • Within any desktop app, select File > Open File... from the menu bar.

You can also set WebCatalog's desktop apps (like Google Docs) or spaces as the default applications for opening Google Drive files by following one of these guides:

  • Set default app for a file type
  • Set default app for a file type

Dashboard

Each space and desktop app now has a dashboard that gives you a quick overview of your subspaces—like apps, games, and accounts—making it easier to access and manage everything in one place.

You can switch it on or off anytime in App/Space Settings > Subspaces > Dashboard.

item.title: September 2024 - Singlebox
item.description:
Based on customer feedback and careful consideration, we're excited to reintroduce the standalone Singlebox app.

The standalone Singlebox app functions much like a space—bringing together all your web apps, messaging services, and emails into one convenient window. However, it can be installed independently of WebCatalog Desktop, with automatic app updates. You can also install it alongside WebCatalog Desktop without any conflicts.

Singlebox shares the same account system and cloud storage as WebCatalog and is included in the WebCatalog subscription, giving you seamless access to both products under a single plan.

item.title: August 2024 - Startup Page
item.description:
You can now choose whether apps, spaces, and subspaces open on the home page or continue where you left off at startup. This setting can be customized for the entire app, game, or space, as well as for individual subspaces.

Team Library

Share apps (including custom apps) and games with your team members (only available for WebCatalog Business subscription).

Enhanced Auto-Reload

We've rebuilt the auto-reload feature to make it more reliable. Now, you can enable auto-reload for the entire app, game, or space, as well as for individual subspaces.

item.title: July 2024 - Mousewheel Zoom
item.description:
On Windows, you can now zoom in and out of a page by holding down the Ctrl key and scrolling up or down with your mousewheel.

Proxy Authentication

WebCatalog now supports proxy servers that require authentication with a username and password. You can save your proxy credentials in settings.

item.title: June 2024 - Private Browsing
item.description: Private Browsing is a new mode that enhances your privacy by not saving your browsing information, such as history and cookies. Once you end the session, no traces of your activity are left behind. You can turn it on in app/game/space's settings > Security & Privacy > Private Browsing.

item.title: April 2024 - Improved Update Experience
item.description:
WebCatalog Desktop now automatically closes running apps, games, and spaces during updates. Once the updates are complete, it seamlessly relaunches them.

Secure DNS (DNS over HTTPS (DoH))

Make it harder for people with access to your internet traffic to see which sites you visit with DNS over HTTPS (DoH). You can turn it on in app/game/space's settings > Security & Privacy > Secure DNS.

item.title: March 2024 - Bookmarks
item.description:
Create bookmarks so WebCatalog can remember your favorite and frequently visited links.

Browsing History

Keep track of the websites or web pages that you have visited.

item.title: January 2024 - Subspace Icon Set
item.description:
Customize your subspace icons with 1000+ icons in our new beautiful icon set.

Download Manager

Manage, pause and resume downloads with the new download manager.

item.title: WizFile 3.13
item.description:
• Fixed issue with "start with windows" and "monitor file system for changes" options not being saved properly on some PCs
  • Fixed possible filter text bug when switching between languages
  • Added "reset configuration to default values" option in File menu

item.title: WizFile 3.12
item.description:
• Fixed bug introduced in 3.11 that could cause WizFile to display a blank form when configured to start with Windows
  • Korean translation updated

item.title: WizFile 3.11
item.description:
• Improved threading when in non Admin mode and when scanning non NTFS drives/network drives/folders, resulting in more than 4x faster scanning of SSD drives
  • fixed some memory leaks that might occur when rescanning or changing drives that could lead to WizFile hanging or crashing
  • improved stability
  • improved handling of multiple monitors with mixed DPI settings
  • Licensing has changed. Commercial users will now purchase licenses based on their business size. These licenses will be valid for all versions of WizTree released within one year of purchase.
    • Previously purchased licenses will be automatically converted to "lifetime" licenses which will be valid for all future versions of WizFile

item.title: WizFile 3.10
item.description:
• Added global "include" and "exclude" filters - go to Options->Filters to configure them.
    The "Include Filter" is applied to all searches automatically, as if it had already been typed into the search field.
    The "Exclude Filter" will automatically exclude any matching items from the search results. It is also applied during the initial scanning process. This can greatly speed up scans by preventing certain folders from being scanned at all, and can also greatly reduce memory use.

    For example, if you use Synology NAS, you can get WizFile to ignore snapshot and recycle folders by setting the "exclude filter" to:
    #snapshot|#recycle|@recycle

    Note that there should not be any spaces between the vertical pipes (vertical pipes are interpreted as "OR" and spaces interpreted as "AND"). The example above will exclude any file or folder name that contains "#snapshot" OR "#recycle" OR "@recycle".

    Another example:
    To exclude the "C:\Windows\WinSxS" and "C:\Program Files" folders from being scanned, you would set the exclude filter to
    C:\Windows\WinSxS\|"C:\Program Files\"
    Note that double quotes are required around filter items that contain spaces.
  • UI tweaked to look like Windows 11 style. To use WizFile classic theme edit the WizFile.ini file (located in %appdata%\WizFile\WizFile.ini or exe folder for portable) and set: UseWizFileClassicTheme=1
  • Fixed rare bug that might cause some folders not to be detected by WizFile when parsing MFT file due to unusual MFT record ordering
  • Unicode characters were not being saved to search drop down history correctly - fixed
  • Emojis were not being displayed correctly in file search and filter fields - fixed
  • When configured to start with Windows, WizFile will now pause for 60 seconds before starting. This it to allow time for virtual drive letters to become available (like Google Drive G:), and to not slow down other important startup tasks due to disk scanning. If WizFile is already configured to start with Windows and you want to enable this delay, toggle the Options->Start With Windows option off and back on. You can edit the delay time by editing the Action in Windows Task Scheduler for the "WizFile" item and changing the value in the /delaysecs=xx parameter
  • WizFile can now be configured to not run as admin - to do this, edit the WizFile.ini file (located in %appdata%\WizFile\WizFile.ini or exe folder for portable) and set
    RunAsAdmin=FALSE
  • new Indonesian translation (thanks to Marcellinus Ferdinand Suciadi)

item.title: WizFile 3.09
item.description:
• Regular Expression search added. To perform a regex search, type in a forward slash followed immediately by the regex, e.g.:
    /[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]\.csv$
    If the regex contains spaces, enclose it in double quotes, like this:
    /"[0-9]{4} [0-9]{2} [0-9]\.csv$"
  • Support for DrivePool, Storage Spaces and other similar "virtual" drives added (WizFile would crash or stop working when scanning these types of drive before)
  • Fixed highlighted text display bug that could occur with certain searches
  • Wildcard search for file extensions was not working correctly when "match entire path" option was used - fixed
    e.g. searching for *.c would include files including ".c" anywhere in the file name, which would include *.cpp or *.c.bak files too.
  • minor interface tweaks
  • New Czech translation added (thanks to DrTactless)

item.title: WizFile 3.08
item.description:
• Search history drop down added to file search. Press down arrow key in search field to display search history items
  • Files with very long file names were not being handled correctly - fixed
  • Date filtering (=today) not working correctly in some time zones - (fixed)
  • Path copy function will now not include a trailing carriage return when only a single file is selected
  • Korean translation updated

item.title: WizFile 3.07
item.description:
• Explorer windows opened with "explore location" or double clicking on path will now always open on top and become active. Previously they may have opened behind other windows and flashed on the task bar.
  • Form would not be restored to correct position if taskbar was not positioned at bottom of screen - fixed
  • Dark mode hint color was wrong - fixed
  • Hint font size will now also match file list font size if zoomed in or out with Ctrl+MouseWheel

item.title: WizFile 3.06
item.description:
• Hovering over a file will now display full path name in status bar at bottom of screen as well as display the full name as a tooltip hint
  • Added new "folders" checkbox to make it easy to toggle folders on or off in the search results
  • Context menu when renaming a file did not close the first time after making a selection - fixed
  • Custom filter items for 3rd filter box were not being saved correctly - fixed
  • dragging/dropping files with names containing non ASCII characters would fail - fixed

item.title: WizFile 3.05
item.description:
• file name search will now ignore character accents (like é and ö) when searching.
    e.g. searching for "melee" will now correctly match file names containing "mêlée" or "MÊLÉE"
  • new file length and path length search terms added:
    Use namelen and pathlen to search by file name and path length
    e.g. to find files with path length greater than 255:
    pathlen>255
    to find file names with exactly 1 character:
    namelen=1
  • Not (!) operator was not working correctly when followed by quoted search text - fixed
  • some results were not being included when using "?" wildcard and searching entire path - fixed
  • File search box and highlighted text were not handling right to left languages like Arabic correctly - fixed
  • Window animations settings could be reset when WizFile was running full screen - fixed
  • WizFile will now handle screens with very high DPI (scaling >=200%) correctly. Previously title bar icons were too small.
  • Light mode header colors were incorrect on Xp/2003 with themes disabled - fixed
  • "Explore folder" and "command prompt here" functions were not working on older versions of Windows if "launch applications as administrator" option was not enabled (XP/2003) - fixed
  • WizFile would not start minimized on older versions of Windows (pre Vista). Toggle "start with windows" off and on again to fix.

item.title: WizFile 3.04
item.description:
• New "Folders" filter option added to "TYPES" filter dropdown.
    Type in "=folder" or "=folders" in search to display folders only.
    Type in "=file" or = "files" in search to display files only.
  • Improved stability
  • Updated GUI and various cosmetic changes
  • Hold down CTRL key and use mousewheel to increase/decrease the search results font size
  • Fixed threading issue that might cause WizFile to hang during high file activity or when rescanning drives
  • Fixed bug where cluster size may have been incorrect leading to incorrect "allocated size" calculations
  • filtering for files with no extension now possible using "*." filter

item.title: WizFile 3.03
item.description:
• Fixed "dark" UI style issues on high DPI screens (some screen elements were not being rendered correctly)
  • Chinese (Traditional) installer was using incorrect translation language files - fixed
  • Minor cosmetic changes

item.title: WizFile 3.02
item.description: • Minimum form size constraints were being ignored so form could be resized too small to be usable - fixed

item.title: WizFile 3.01
item.description: • WizFile was ignoring the "check for updates" option and checking for updates each time it started - fixed

item.title: WizFile 3.00
item.description:
• added 2 new predefined filter dropdowns - one for size and one for file modified date. These can be customised by the user.
  • added file size, allocated size and modified date filter support.

    Use operators "=", ">", ">=", "<", "<=" to filter files based on size or modified date. NB: Don't put any spaces between operators and values!
    e.g. to find files less than 100 bytes in size:
    <100
    Append a 'k', 'm', 'g', or 't' to the number to search in Kb, Mb, Gb, Tb
    e.g. to find files between 500MB and 1Gb:
    >=500m <=1g
    'kb', 'mb', 'gb', 'tb' can also be used, e.g.:
    >=500mb <=1gb

    To filter by "allocated" size, use "a=", "a>", etc.
    e.g. To find files with allocated size between 100MB and 200MB:
    a>=100m a<=200m
    e.g. to find files with 0 allocated size and greater than zero file size:
    a=0 >0

    To filter by date, specify a date in the format: yyyy/mm/dd
    e.g. Filter files modified before 2020/01/01:
    <2020/01/01

    Use the constant "today" to reference today's date. Optionally add or subtract a number of days from this constant.
    e.g. to find files modified in the last 7 days:
    >=today-7

    e.g. to find all files larger than 1gb that were modified in the last month (last 30 days):
    >=1gb >=today-30

    Place the search item in quotes to force a file name search.
    e.g. to find file names that contain "=0" instead of displaying files with zero size:
    "=0"
  • new "not" operator. Start the search expression with an exclamation mark (!) to find files that don't match the expression.
    e.g. to find files that don't contain "windows":
    !windows
    e.g. to find all files that contain "music" but are not of type mp3:
    music !*.mp3
    e.g. to find files that are between 1 and 100 bytes in size, but not 50:
    >=1 <=100 !=50
  • new "Launch applications as administrator" option (off by default).
    If enabled, any applications launched by WizFile will have administrator rights (this was the default for previous versions of WizFile as WizFile always runs as administrator). It's recommended that this option be left off. This also helps Wizfile work better with applications already running non elevated (without administrator rights).
    For example, context menu items like "Add to Windows Media Player list" would not work previously if Windows Media Player has already been launched in non elevated mode (a "Server execution failed" error would have occurred).
  • Support for Windows Dark Mode. UI Theme can be set via new "UI Theme" menu option.
  • Windows Explorer integration added. Will be on by default if using the non portable version.
  • New "Clear and Reset Filters" option added (Shift+F6). Clears and resets filters. Hold shift key when clicking on 'Clear' button to reset filters when clearning search results.
  • file search speed increased significantly
  • Minimising WizFile will now minimize to task bar instead of tray
  • Fixed some MFT decoding bugs which could have caused crashes on some PCs
  • Added global hotkey Ctrl+Win+W to bring WizFile to the foreground if it's active
  • Stability improvements
